Class ScopePipeline.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.scope.ScopePipeline.Builder
Enclosing class:

public static final class ScopePipeline.Builder extends Object
Mutable assembly helper; building copies the list, but shares its scope objects.

    • when

      public ScopePipeline.Builder when(boolean condition, Scope scope)
      Appends an already constructed scope when a condition is true. The caller has already evaluated the scope argument; use ifMod(ModCompat, Supplier) for lazy construction involving optional classes.
      Parameters:
      condition - whether to include the scope
      scope - non-null scope when included
      Returns:
      this builder

    • ifMod

      public ScopePipeline.Builder ifMod(ModCompat mod, Supplier<Scope> scopeFactory)
      Constructs and appends a scope only when the optional mod is loaded. Lazy construction keeps absent integration implementations off this path.
      Parameters:
      mod - compatibility gate to inspect
      scopeFactory - supplier invoked once when the gate passes
      Returns:
      this builder

    • build

      public ScopePipeline build()
      Copies the current ordered list into a pipeline. Do not concurrently enter pipelines that share the same scope instances.

      Building again reuses the same scope objects. Disposing either pipeline also disposes those shared scopes. Use fresh scope instances for pipelines that need independent lifetimes.

      Returns:
      pipeline with independent entry bookkeeping
